description: This file contains CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations for managing 'Run' entities within a test management system. It includes functions for retrieving runs by ID, status, test file, or test case, as well as creating new runs and updating their status and related metadata.

methods.name: Optional[Run] get_run(db: Session, run_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieve a single run record by its unique ID.

methods.name: List[Run] get_runs(db: Session, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, status: Optional[RunStatus] = None)
methods.description: Retrieve a list of runs, optionally filtered by status, with pagination support.

methods.name: Run create_run(db: Session, run: RunCreate)
methods.description: Create a new run record in the database with initial status QUEUED.

methods.name: Optional[Run] update_run_status( db: Session, run_id: int, status: RunStatus, error_message: Optional[str] = None, log_path: Optional[str] = None, output_path: Optional[str] = None, report_path: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Update the status and other relevant fields of an existing run, setting timestamps as appropriate.

methods.name: List[Run] get_runs_by_test_file(db: Session, test_file_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieve all runs associated with a specific test file.

methods.name: List[Run] get_runs_by_testcase(db: Session, testcase_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieve all runs associated with a specific test case.
